units.rawText: And... I'm also glad that you stopped me back then, and the Oasis wasn't swallowed by the Operand Black Hole. Otherwise, I'd never have gotten to experience any of these fun things.

spans.text: And... I'm also glad that you stopped me back then, and the Oasis wasn't swallowed by the Operand Black Hole. Otherwise, I'd never have gotten to experience any of these fun things.

units.rawText: Every day in the Oasis, I get to collect so much interesting data. Sister Chanzhi's embroidery, Sister Daiyan's guzheng, Sister Jessie's Complete Guide to Cleaning, Sister Erika's comic books... It reminds me all over again how wonderful it is to experience all of this for myself.
